operators.name: einsum_bmm_fused
semantics: Compute y = einsum('bij,bjk->bik', x, x), which is per-batch matrix multiplication y[b] = x[b] @ x[b].
Then compute z = bmm(y, y), which is per-batch matrix multiplication z[b] = y[b] @ y[b].
Per-batch matrix multiplication: for each batch b, y[b] = x[b] @ x[b].
Input and output are 3D contiguous tensors of shape [B, N, N], float32, CUDA.
Per-batch matrix multiplication: for each batch b, z[b] = y[b] @ y[b].
Both inputs are the output of step_001.
Return the final tensor z of shape [B, N, N].
